summary: Murphy USA Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a $500 million private placement of 5.875% senior notes due 2034 by its subsidiary Murphy Oil USA, Inc. The notes are issued at par, guaranteed by Murphy USA and certain domestic subsidiaries, and are unregistered, offered only to QIBs and non-U.S. persons. The expected closing is May 27, 2026. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation event.
